summary: Build practical DfAM, qualification, and production planning skills in 5 days. Enquire about this advanced course today.
lede: Additive manufacturing training helps design, production, and quality professionals assess production opportunities and plan a controlled workflow. It covers process and material selection, design for additive manufacturing, build preparation, post-processing, and inspection planning. Participants also develop skills in qualification and risk control, cost modelling, and presenting a production roadmap for review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with design, production, quality, or industrialization decisions and now need to apply additive manufacturing with greater confidence and control.
prerequisites: You should arrive with a working knowledge of manufacturing processes, engineering drawings, CAD fundamentals, and basic quality terminology. Experience in product development, production engineering, quality assurance, or industrial design will help you get more value from the workshops. No programming is required, although familiarity with digital design tools, slicing workflows, and data-driven reporting will be useful. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted topology optimization and in-process monitoring are covered at an operational application level, not as software engineering.
